## `neuro.string.fromCodePoint`

Static method on `String`. Variadic items live under `codePoints`.

> Return the String value whose elements are, in order, the elements in the List elements.
> If length is 0, the empty string is returned.

## Signatures

```ts
fromCodePoint(input: { codePoints: number[]; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `String.fromCodePoint` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.

## Example

<Code
  lang="ts"

  wrap
